Where models live

Source: R/models.R
laya_model_root.Rd

layaR keeps exported checkpoints in a model root folder with one subfolder per checkpoint (multilingual/, english/, typed-decisions/). The root is, in order: the layaR.model_root option, the LAYA_ONNX_ROOT environment variable (shared with Laya's Rust SDK), or the user cache folder tools::R_user_dir("layaR", "cache") plus onnx/. Downloads and imports go there.

Usage

laya_model_root()

laya_model_path(checkpoint = c("multilingual", "english", "typed-decisions"))

laya_model_available(
  checkpoint = getOption("layaR.checkpoint", "multilingual")
)

Arguments

checkpoint

A checkpoint name.

Value

laya_model_root() and laya_model_path() return paths (the latter is where layaR installs checkpoint); laya_model_available() returns TRUE when a complete export is found in either place.

Details

When a checkpoint isn't in the model root, layaR also looks in the cache that Laya's other SDKs share (~/.cache/laya/onnx, or %LOCALAPPDATA%/laya/onnx on Windows), so a model exported or downloaded for the Rust or TypeScript SDK is reused. layaR never writes there. Set options(layaR.shared_cache = FALSE) to turn this off.

See also

laya_models(), laya_download_model(), laya_import_model()

Examples

laya_model_root()
#> [1] "/home/runner/.cache/R/layaR/onnx"
laya_model_path("english")
#> [1] "/home/runner/.cache/R/layaR/onnx/english"
laya_model_available()
#> [1] FALSE
